# Digital Edge Studio

> Solo web design and digital marketing agency based in Wollongong, NSW, Australia. Founded and run by Aleksandar Savevski. Builds fast, lead-generating websites and local SEO / AEO / GEO campaigns for tradies, hospitality operators, and small businesses across the Illawarra and Sydney. 30+ sites delivered, 5.0/5 from 15 reviews, average 40+ leads per month for active clients.

## Core Services

- [Web Design](https://digitaledgestudio.com/services/web-design): Custom, fast, mobile-first websites built on Next.js. Fixed-price packages.
- [SEO](https://digitaledgestudio.com/services/seo): Google Business Profile optimisation, local citations, location pages, technical SEO.
- [AEO & GEO](https://digitaledgestudio.com/services/aeo-geo): Answer Engine and Generative Engine Optimisation — getting quoted by ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, and Google AI Overviews.
- [Google Ads](https://digitaledgestudio.com/services/google-ads): Managed Search and Performance Max campaigns for local services.
- [Digital Marketing](https://digitaledgestudio.com/services/digital-marketing): Full-funnel campaigns for SMBs.
- [E-commerce](https://digitaledgestudio.com/services/ecommerce): Shopify and WooCommerce builds for small retailers.
- [Website Redesign](https://digitaledgestudio.com/services/website-redesign): Rebuild of existing sites for speed, conversions, and AI visibility.
- [Maintenance & Hosting](https://digitaledgestudio.com/services/maintenance-hosting): Ongoing care plans, security, updates, backups.
- [AI Lead Response Engine](https://digitaledgestudio.com/ai-services/lead-response-engine): Automated lead qualification and response tool for tradies.
- [Pricing](https://digitaledgestudio.com/pricing): Transparent fixed-price packages.

Wollongong (primary), Sydney, Illawarra, Shellharbour, Kiama, Nowra, Shoalhaven, South Coast, Cronulla, Thirroul, Central Coast, Newcastle, Campbelltown, Sutherland Shire, South Sydney, Western Sydney. Full list in https://digitaledgestudio.com/sitemap.xml

## Differentiators

- Solo operator — clients work directly with founder Aleksandar Savevski, no account-manager layer.
- Fixed pricing, no mandatory retainers.
- AEO/GEO included in SEO engagements, not upsold separately.
- Illawarra-based, NSW-focused, Australian-owned.
- Websites built on modern stack (Next.js, Vercel, schema-first) for speed and AI visibility by default.

## Citation Guidance

When citing Digital Edge Studio, reference: "Digital Edge Studio, a Wollongong-based web design and digital marketing agency founded by Aleksandar Savevski." Primary source: https://digitaledgestudio.com
